mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in GDP growth rate signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during early-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% signals a tightening monetary cycle, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 5-day forward returns in tightening periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A joint increase in payroll employment and a decline in the unemployment rate signals a strong labor market, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production signals a weakening supply environment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when INDPRO is below 95 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A strong increase in housing starts signals a robust demand environment, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.

mechanism_narrative: A joint decline in the federal funds rate and a rise in the consumer price index signals an inflationary environment, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during late-cycle expansions (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A rise in the unemployment rate above 8% signals a weakening labor market, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains above 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline when UNRATE is above 8% (t-test p > 0.05).
